# data.docker_service

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Looks up one swarm service (`GET /services/{id}`) by `id` or `name`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. `inspect` holds the whole Engine service object (spec, endpoint, update status), `published_ports` the ports it publishes; only the container environment inside it is sensitive.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version the provider negotiated with the daemon (GET /version ApiVersion, capped by the client's max). |
| `id` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Service ID or a unique ID prefix; resolved to the full ID. Conflicts with `name`. |
| `image_digest_ref` | `string` | computed |  |  | Image the tasks run, pinned by digest (`repo@sha256:...`); null when the daemon did not pin one. |
| `inspect` | `object` | computed |  |  | The service inspect response as a nested object mirroring Service field by field (snake_case). Only ContainerSpec.Env and volume driver options are sensitive (field-level); the rest, including Args/Command, stays plain in plans. |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_service" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

# Pin a downstream deployment to the exact image the service runs.
output "web_image" {
  value = data.docker_service.web.image_digest_ref
}

output "web_published_ports" {
  value = [for p in data.docker_service.web.published_ports : p.published_port]
}
```
